_notice: SYNTHETIC DATA. Every factory, buyer, framework, document and reference number in this file was invented for the ThreadLight prototype. Clause text and document fields are pre-extracted sample results, not output of a live OCR or language model.
scenario: A factory 30 days before an audit
framework: Buyer A Code of Conduct v3.2 (synthetic)

requirements.title: Valid fire safety certificate
requirements.text: The supplier shall hold a fire safety certificate issued by the competent authority that is valid on the date of the audit.

requirements.title: Structural safety assessment
requirements.text: The supplier shall provide a structural safety assessment by a qualified engineer that remains valid on the date of the audit.

requirements.title: Valid trade license
requirements.text: The supplier shall operate under a trade license, in the registered name of the facility, valid on the date of the audit.

requirements.title: Environmental clearance
requirements.text: The supplier shall hold an environmental clearance for the facility, in the registered name of the facility, valid on the date of the audit.

requirements.title: Fire drill records
requirements.text: The supplier shall keep records of fire drills conducted within the last 180 days, carried out under a valid fire safety certificate.

requirements.title: Wage and working-hour records
requirements.text: The supplier shall maintain wage and working-hour records for all workers and make a summary available to the auditor.

requirements.title: Safety committee minutes
requirements.text: The supplier shall keep minutes of safety committee meetings, including references to the safety documents reviewed.

requirements.title: Closure proof for corrective action CAP-14
requirements.text: Corrective actions reported as complete shall be supported by closure evidence such as dated photographs or a verification note.

corrective_actions.title: Clear and re-mark blocked emergency exit, Floor 2
